# Bharat AI Innovation Conference & Exhibition 2026

> India's B2B AI conference and exhibition — the organisations already running AI in production, the companies providing it, and the policymakers shaping it. Generative AI, large language models, agentic AI, AI governance and enterprise AI deployment, across 10+ conference tracks and a 93-booth exhibition floor. Held at World Trade Center Mumbai on **20–21 November 2026**.

## Event facts

- **Event name:** Bharat AI Innovation Conference & Exhibition 2026
- **Dates:** 20–21 November 2026 (2 days)
- **Venue:** World Trade Center Mumbai, Cuffe Parade, Mumbai 400005, Maharashtra, India
- **Organizer:** Aegis Knowledge Trust
- **Contact:** info@bharataiinnovation.com | +91 89765 80367
- **Website:** https://bharataiinnovation.com/
- **Registration:** https://bharataiinnovation.com/register (free registration is closed; passes from ₹999 + GST); every pass compared at https://bharataiinnovation.com/passes
- **Format:** In-person (offline)
- **Language:** English

## What it is

Bharat AI Innovation 2026 is India's B2B platform for AI, run as a two-day conference and exhibition, covering Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), enterprise AI deployment, AI governance and ethics, AI startups, AI for industry verticals (BFSI, healthcare, manufacturing, retail, agriculture, government), AI talent and skills, deep learning research, and the Indian AI ecosystem. It includes 10+ conference tracks across 4 halls, a 27,238 sq.ft exhibition floor with 93 booths across 8 industry zones, and AI/ML training workshops.

## Positioning

Bharat AI Innovation is India's B2B platform for AI, not a footfall exhibition. It brings together the organisations already running AI in production (enterprise CIOs, CDOs, CTOs, procurement heads, and state and central government departments), the companies providing it (AI startups, product companies and solution providers) and the policymakers shaping it (MeitY, Maharashtra MITRA, ministers). Business mechanisms: sponsor-curated CXO AI Leadership Panels; an Innovation Stage (8-minute main-stage slot, bundled with select booth packages); four private boardrooms at WTC Mumbai bookable by the hour (₹10,000–₹15,000 per hour + GST); Bharat AI Connect (every pass can view the attendee directory; AI matchmaking, connection requests and 1:1 meeting booking need a paid pass, from the Expo Pass up); and the Bharat AI Leaders’ Evening.

## Sponsorship and branding options (INR, excluding GST)

- **Title Partner** — ₹1.2 Cr (1 slot, exclusive): "[Your Company] Presents" positioning, opening and closing keynotes (20 min each), 90-min panel plus 3 more 60-min panels, 2 Innovation Talks, Mega Pavilion 7×7.7 m, TV broadcast (1M+ viewers), hosts the Leaders’ Evening, 2 meeting rooms for both days, roadshow sessions, 190 passes (50 VIP, 100 Delegate, 20 Media, 20 Educator)
- **Powered Partner** — ₹50 Lakhs (1 slot, exclusive): "Powered by" branding, 15-min keynote, 60-min leadership panel, 8-min Innovation Talk, 30-min roadshow, Mega Pavilion 7×7.7 m, meeting room for both days, 20 VIP + 30 Delegate passes
- **Knowledge Partner** — ₹30 Lakhs (1 slot, exclusive): Knowledge Partner recognition, co-shape themes and tracks, 12-min keynote, 60-min leadership panel, 8-min Innovation Talk, premium exhibition presence (valued ₹10 Lakhs), 10 VIP + 15 Delegate passes
- **Associate Partner** — ₹25 Lakhs (4 slots, one per sector: FinTech, HealthTech, AgriTech, MfgTech): category exclusivity, 10-min keynote, 60-min leadership panel, 8-min Innovation Talk, premium exhibition presence (valued ₹7 Lakhs), 10 VIP + 15 Delegate passes
- **Innovation Partner** — custom: innovation zone branding, panel slot, award category sponsor, startup pavilion integration
- **AI Leadership Panel** — ₹10 Lakhs: sponsor-curated CXO panel with theme and moderation rights, "Powered by" branding, 5 VIP + 10 delegate passes
- **Leaders Round Table** — ₹10 Lakhs: co-branded AI policy round table with government and industry leaders
- **Bharat AI Leaders’ Evening Partner** — ₹15 Lakhs: "hosted by" the sponsor, welcome toast, panel discussion slot, CXO and policymaker guest list; at WTC Mumbai, or The Taj Mahal Palace / Trident Nariman Point for ₹15 Lakhs more
- **Lanyard** — ₹10 Lakhs: the only brand on every attendee lanyard, both days
- **Conference Bag** — ₹3 Lakhs: the only brand on the delegate conference bag
- **Networking Lunch Partner**, **AI Partner** — on request
- **Trophy Partner**, **Innovators' Round Table**, and custom activations (product launch, MoU signing, hackathon, TV/YouTube panel, road show) — on request
- **Call for workshop partners:** individuals and AI companies can submit a workshop proposal; the organisers decide and let them know, at https://bharataiinnovation.com/training-workshop#workshop-partners
- Sponsorship contact: partner@bharataiinnovation.com | +91 89765 80367

## Pass types and pricing (INR)

- **Expo Pass** — ₹999 + GST (the exhibition floor only, guaranteed entry on both days, the networking app; no conference, no AI Innovation Talk and Showcase, no lunch, no workshop). Free registration is closed: the free Visitor Pass is no longer offered (people who already hold one keep it).
- **Student Pass** — ₹999 + GST (conference + one hands-on workshop + student zone; students with a valid student ID; no lunch; students may take up to half of each workshop's seats)
- **Academic Pass** — ₹3,999 + GST (conference + student zone; faculty and researchers with a valid ID; no lunch or workshop)
- **Delegate Pass** — ₹8,999 + GST (full conference + exhibition + networking lunch; no workshop)
- **Premium Delegate Pass** — ₹14,999 + GST (everything in Delegate + one hands-on workshop)
- **VIP Pass** — ₹24,999 + GST (everything in Premium Delegate + the Bharat AI Leaders’ Evening on Day 1, VIP lounge, priority seating, speaker meet & greet)
- **Entry:** every paid pass has guaranteed entry on both days. Free registration is closed, and there is no on-spot registration at the venue: bring your pass and a government photo ID.
- **Dated prices:** these prices apply from 6 November 2026 and may go up again. Until 5 November they were Academic ₹999, Delegate ₹4,999, Premium Delegate ₹9,999, VIP ₹19,999 (+ GST).
- **Groups:** passes of one kind in one booking (Delegate, Premium Delegate or VIP), paid online: 3 or 4 passes, 15% off each; 5 or more, 30% off each at https://bharataiinnovation.com/group. Each person gets their own pass by email.
- **Moving up:** a confirmed Student, Academic, Delegate or Premium Delegate pass can be upgraded online for the difference between the two list prices, from the pass card in the app.
- Workshop seats are limited and go first come, first served. Comparison: https://bharataiinnovation.com/passes
- **Media Pass** and **Influencer Pass** — by approval, free: journalists and creators apply at https://bharataiinnovation.com/media-pass; the team reviews every request and replies by email within 2 working days
- **Team packages:** Team 5–9, Enterprise 10–19, Corporate 20+

Featured sessions: "AI, Trust and Evolving Skills using IBM Bob", a 90-minute hands-on workshop by IBM led by KrishnaKanth Naik (Program Manager, IBM Career Education) on checking the security of the Skills an agentic AI uses (Fri 20 Nov, 11:30, Raman Theatre; bring a laptop with IBM Bob installed); "From Prototype to Production: Building Enterprise AI with Forward-Deployed Engineers", a 90-minute live-coding workshop by Dr. Ashish Tendulkar (PhD, IIT Bombay; Google AI); "Automatic Speech Recognition (Speech-to-Text)", a 90-minute hands-on workshop by Dr. Parijat Shukla (PhD in Machine Learning, Iowa State University); "LLM Fine-Tuning, Hands-On", a 2-hour hands-on workshop in Google Colab by Virendra Pal (AI and FinTech Expert; alumnus, Aegis School of Data Science and AI); plus a closed-door, 60-minute CXO Roundtable, "Building the Enterprise AI Workforce: Talent, Delivery and the Rise of Forward-Deployed Engineering", moderated by Bhupesh Daheria (CEO, Aegis School of Data Science & AI; Aegis Super Intelligence Lab) with Dr. Vinay Kulkarni and Dr. Ashish Tendulkar, for L&D Heads, Delivery Heads, Chief AI Officers, Chief Data Officers, CIOs and CTOs
- [Partner](https://bharataiinnovation.com/partner): Sponsorship tiers, individually priced branding and activation options, AI Leadership Panel, startup path
- [AI Readiness Certification](https://bharataiinnovation.com/ai-readiness): Independent AI maturity rating and certification, an Aegis Graham Bell Awards initiative
- [Networking](https://bharataiinnovation.com/networking): Bharat AI Connect (AI matchmaking, connection requests and 1:1 meeting booking) and four private WTC Mumbai boardrooms bookable by the hour (₹10,000–₹15,000 per hour + GST)
- [Accommodation](https://bharataiinnovation.com/accommodation): Premium hotels near WTC Mumbai
- [Government](https://bharataiinnovation.com/government): For Ministries, Departments, State Governments and PSUs: how to showcase AI initiatives at Bharat AI Innovation 2026 (innovation talk and showcase, keynote and panel, closed-door roundtable, live demonstration, launch, a Government Pavilion on the exhibition floor, and a showcase for startups from incubation centres under Ministries) and a form to nominate an initiative. The event is organised by Aegis Knowledge Trust and is not a government event
- [Delhi 2027](https://bharataiinnovation.com/delhi): The Delhi edition, a separate event: 28-29 July 2027 at Bharat Mandapam, Pragati Maidan, New Delhi. Keynotes, panel discussions, Innovation Talks and Showcase by startups, corporates, government departments, ministries and state governments, AI workshops, hackathons, closed-door roundtables, an exhibition, cross-border dialogue and B2B networking. Delegate (Rs 4,999), Premium Delegate (Rs 9,999), VIP (Rs 19,999) and Academic (Rs 999) passes, all + 18% GST, are on sale at https://bharataiinnovation.com/delhi-register. The free Visitor Pass (exhibition only, entry by time slot; registrants join a waitlist), and partnerships at Mumbai's titles and prices are open on the page. Booths, at Mumbai's sizes and prices, are applied for at https://bharataiinnovation.com/delhi-exhibit: the team reviews every application and replies within 2 working days. The floor plan comes later

Given out after a short form (name, email, phone)

## Common questions

- **When and where is Bharat AI Innovation 2026?** 20–21 November 2026, 09:00–18:00 IST each day, at World Trade Center Mumbai, Cuffe Parade, Mumbai.
- **Is it free to attend?** No. Free registration is closed, and there is no on-spot registration. Passes, all + 18% GST: Expo ₹999 (the exhibition floor only), Student ₹999 (with a workshop), Academic ₹3,999, Delegate ₹8,999, Premium Delegate ₹14,999, VIP ₹24,999. Every paid pass has guaranteed entry on both days and the networking app; all but the Expo Pass include the conference. Buy at https://bharataiinnovation.com/register.
- **Who is it for?** Enterprise and government buyers of AI (CIOs, CDOs, CTOs, procurement heads), AI builders (startups, product companies, solution providers), policymakers, and investors.
- **How do I exhibit?** Book one of 93 booths across 8 industry zones, from the Startup Pod at ₹48,000 + GST to the Mega Pavilion at ₹17,40,000 + GST. See https://bharataiinnovation.com/exhibition.
- **How do I sponsor?** Every sponsorship and branding option is priced separately at https://bharataiinnovation.com/partner, or write to partner@bharataiinnovation.com.
- **Who organises it?** Aegis Knowledge Trust.

## Key topics

Generative AI, LLMs, ChatGPT, GPT-4, Claude, Gemini, RAG, AI agents, multimodal AI, foundation models, AI governance, AI ethics, responsible AI, AI policy India, AI for BFSI, AI for healthcare, AI for manufacturing, AI for agriculture, AI for retail, MLOps, AI infrastructure, GPU compute, AI startups India, AI funding, AI talent, AI skilling, deep learning, computer vision, NLP, India AI Mission, IndiaAI, sovereign AI, Bharat AI ecosystem.

## Why attend

- Meet senior policymakers including representatives from MeitY and IndiaAI Mission
- Network with 5,000+ AI professionals, founders, researchers, and enterprise leaders
- See live demos across 93 booths in 8 AI industry zones
- Attend deep-dive technical workshops on GenAI, LLMs, MLOps, and AI deployment
- Establish partnerships across India's growing AI ecosystem
